title: Anonymous to Cristiano Pagni, undated, a full-page cipher letter (ASF, Mediceo del Principato 444, c. 315; catalogue 2348): read in part

steps.what: Pass 1 of c. 315r-v from the IIIF images: 1,560 sign tokens (passes/).

Own annealer with Italian quadgrams on pass 1: the vowels came out (1 a, 3 e, 5 i, 7 o) but no reading; -4.397 against -4.854 for shuffled order. Cause found later: about 18% of signs differ between two passes of the same reader (dots), the repeat sign was treated as a letter, m and n were merged.
Pass 2 by the same reader from new crops, pass 1 not reopened; 1,521 signs, frozen (md5) before alignment and before any decoding. Pass 1 and pass 2 agree on 1,282 of 1,564 aligned positions (82.0%).

From repeats in pass 2 on the recto ('8 x 3 9 9' 7' questo, '8 x 3 5'' quel, '2 7 6'' con): a bare figure and its dotted form are neighbouring letters. The whole key follows; the verso, not used for it, read on sight. No crib and no gloss.

Frozen pass 2 under the key against 5,000 shuffled keys: 0 of 5,000 as good. Key taken from the first 80% of units and applied to V04-V10: 0 of 5,000. First count 1,364 of 1,521 (89.7%), a measure since withdrawn.

Pass 3, not blind: every flagged unit re-viewed on tiles (309 verdicts). Rule for m and n from the image (plain 6, dotted 6); a dot above the 2 is a null. Count with the codes as read 1,391 of 1,521 (91.5%), since withdrawn.

Outside red-team review (four agents, not Anthropic models) of the claim: recovery plausible, 'read' weak, date unresolved, priority not established. Accepted: codes are not read unless fixed by a clear duplicate (1,368 of 1,521, 89.94%); literal layer and per-unit ledger built; meaning-critical words checked on crops (lansa without c, disrmara without a).

Unaided solver run on the pass-3 signs against five frequency-preserving permutations, same budget: real -4.300, best control -5.082; the unaided key matches the hand key on 1,172 of 1,345 single-letter units (87.1%).
Blind third transcription by another session that opened only the two images: same sign as pass 3 at 1,395 of 1,521 units (91.72%); under the same key and rule 1,347 of 1,521 (88.56%).

Adjudication of the 138 units where pass 3 and the blind transcription differ, on crops with the label hidden: pass 3 right at 60, the blind reader at 41, both possible at 34, neither at 3; seven units of pass 3 have no sign on the image. 'fino a adesso' became 'fino adesso', 'sabere' 'sapere', 'poser' 'poter'. Count 1,369 of 1,514 (90.42%).
Date from the content: scored late Oct 1555, 20 Nov 1555 and 20 Mar 1556 against Romier, Sauze, Serristori and the Venetian calendar; late October 1555 favoured, but the dateline month begins with m.

Looked for Serristori's letter of 24 Oct 1555 (Mediceo 3274 c. 460) and the Florence cipher registers: not online. Found that the pledging of Cervia and Ravenna recurs (Ribier, June 1554; Duruy p. 212, January 1557), so the date was widened to late 1555 to early 1557, unresolved.

Check by Daniel Bourdeau on issue 426: a decoder written from the key agrees with the decryption on all 1,514 units; strict 1,368 or 1,369 of 1,514 (90.4%); 0 of 5,000 shuffled keys; images not reached. He points out 69 signs dropped as nulls by context, that the pairing is not supported for g/h and is weak for a/b, and that the code values are from context.

For this folder: the three corrected words checked again on the image (they hold); the clear opening re-read (our pass-3 version of the second line was wrong); fr[an]zesi and a doubled a found undeclared; the dropped signs tallied by position (61 of 62 at word boundaries); every unit not read listed.

Searches for an edition or decipherment: the repository, the inventory, archive.org full text of four printed collections, the Venetian calendar, the web. Nothing found. The Medici Archive Project database, Cantagalli and Ancel were not searched.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1320 tokens, 37 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -1.866 per letter; random keys -4.989 (z 5.5); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.959 (mean -3.007, z 30.8); annealer on the real text -1.866. Verdict: pass.

Independent verification before the write-up: scripts/build.py re-run in a copy (all outputs identical); own decoder from key.tsv agrees with the key on 1,369 of 1,369 read units; Sectigo token and 28 stamped files checked; ASF images fetched (HTTP 200) and lines R03-R04 compared (about 100 signs, digits agree, dots not decidable at 2000 px); shuffled-key control 0 of 5,000 by the first verifier.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.866; polyphony 0.0; 194 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -1.866

outcome.method_basis: The key was read off repeated groups in a frozen transcription (questo, quel, con) with no crib and no gloss; the leaf carries no decipherment, and an unaided annealer run on the signs recovers 87% of the same key.
outcome.fraction_read_source: units.tsv and counts.txt (scripts/build.py): of 1,514 cipher units, 1,369 give the accepted value by the key from every sign the image allows (letters, repeat sign, word signs, key nulls); 137 are not read (52 letters by context or left open by the image, 62 signs dropped as nulls by context, 23 code signs); 8 are unread. The reviewer's figure is the same (1,368 or 1,369). The blind third transcription alone gives 1,347 of 1,521 (88.56%).

gaps.item: 8 unread signs, among them a looped sign three times at the start of a clause
gaps.detail: holes.md 1; no image larger than 2000 px.

gaps.item: 11 code signs, 23 units: A, L, S, G, B, D, Q, m, n, d and an ampersand
gaps.detail: Proposed from context only (A Papa, L Duca, S Siena, G Cardinale, B Imperatore); none is fixed by a duplicate. A dated letter in the same cipher or the key register would fix them.

gaps.item: h, and 62 signs dropped as nulls by context (mostly single-dotted t, l and b between words)
gaps.detail: 61 of 62 stand at word boundaries like the key nulls: a separator class, or two-dot nulls with a dot not visible at 2000 px. The pairing g/h is not shown by this text.
Dateline 'el dj xx. m' with a bar, no year; content points to late 1555 to early 1557. Serristori's letter of 24 Oct 1555 (Mediceo 3274 c. 460) is not online.

gaps.item: Whether c. 318 is the address leaf of this letter
gaps.detail: Probable from the nesting of the neighbouring bifolia; no image shows the two leaves joined.

texts.label: Anonymous to Cristiano Pagni, undated, MdP 444 c. 315r-v
texts.summary: A report to Cosimo I's secretary, probably from Rome. The writer has stayed on at the request of the Marquis of Sarria to watch a negotiation with a person hidden as A (the Pope, if the proposed value holds). A friend who knows French secrets says 'ours' will be deceived. A league is being negotiated, with Cervia and Ravenna to be pledged to L 'of Ferrara' for money; 'Monsignor di Lansa', arrived the evening before, presses it, and G 'of Lorraine' is expected. The writer suspects the French have already settled with A and are playing for time, to see whether L 'Ottavio' and his troops can force S to an accord with A as depositary. A is the bitter enemy of B and of L and has shown it openly; money is being spent, horse are coming from Mirandola and Parma, and when A disarms the French will take on the soldiers. The writer asks leave to go to n and to be kept in the good grace of L. Context: Franco-papal dealings against the Imperial side and Florence under Paul IV, between late 1555 and early 1557; the date is not established.

reading_review.by: integration reviewer (a model session, not a person), 12 Nov 2026
reading_review.note: Read as sentences against the translation. The letter runs as connected Italian from start to end and the argument can be followed. Holes: code signs in most sentences (five with a value proposed from context, six with none), 8 unread signs, and about forty words that hold a letter the key does not give from the sign on the image; all are marked in place. The contributor's own review (Claude, the session that prepared the files) is not independent and is replaced by this one.

texts.note: read_share is the share of the 1,514 cipher units read by the key from every sign the image allows (units.tsv, counts.txt): the one rule of this folder. A word count of reading.md that the folder gave (279 words, 95 holes, 0.746) does not add up and is not used. transcription_blind.txt is the blind third transcription in its own sign names; pass 1 is in passes/, pass 2 and pass 3 in timestamps/stamped/.

outcome.notes: Filed as read in part, at 1,369 of 1,514 units (90.4%). The 89.7% and 91.5% of the first day are withdrawn and 91.72% is a sign-agreement figure, not a share read (counts.txt). contribution 'catalogue correction' is for the date only: the catalogue's 'late March 1555' does not fit the content and nothing firmer is put in its place. Checked at integration (12 Nov 2026): build.py reproduces every file and figure; an independent decoder agrees on all 1,369 read units; the stamp matches its files (the order of events is by the contributor's record); two lines of the ASF image were compared by the verifier (agree); docs/_validate.py gives pass on the units read by the key. The solver run and the optimised null controls were not re-run. The contributor id mcbratney is in contributors.json.

prior.where: None found; priority not established. Checked on 11-12 Nov 2026: this repository (catalogue row 2348 open, no target folder); ASF inventory VII pp. 385-398 (no decipherment noted); archive.org full text of Sauze, Correspondance politique de Lanssac, Romier, Les origines politiques II, Serristori's Legazioni and Desjardins III (OCR, not page by page); Calendar of State Papers Venice VI nos. 418-431; web searches. Not checked: the Medici Archive Project database (login), Cantagalli, Ancel, the Cifrari series of the Florence archive (not digitised).

human: Malcolm McBratney directed the work, set the rules (every attempt recorded, transcriptions frozen before decoding, a blind transcription by a separate session, shuffled-key controls, an outside red-team review, no claim without its check) and sent the result; Claude sessions picked the letter from the catalogue, transcribed, solved, read and checked. No reading by a person without AI.
